before-starting-below-ice-mountain.player: I think you have had enough.

after-completing-below-ice-mountain.player: How you holding up Burntof? Must have had quite the fright when you woke that monster.

after-completing-below-ice-mountain.npc: You're right [lad/lass]. It did give me a little fright.
But I saw some interesting things down in the ruins...
Some of the markings on the wall look very familiar to me. I've seen them before.

after-completing-below-ice-mountain.player: Well, when I defeated the monster, an Imcando dwarf opened the barred door...

after-completing-below-ice-mountain.npc: An Imcando dwarf! I thought they were all but extinct! You've found something truly amazing [player name]!
I wish I had a drink to celebrate, but this desert is bone dry.
